column1: # mapping_set_title: "MII Onkologie / oBDS 3.0.5 -> ECCDM element crosswalk"

# comment: "Direction: subject (oBDS) <predicate> object (ECCDM hub). Extension cols: subject_terminology, source_context (oBDS Meldeanlass: Diagnose|Verlauf|Pathologie|OP|Strahlentherapie|SystemischeTherapie|Tod|Tumorkonferenz), element_kind (collected|calculated), review_status (proposed|reviewed). v0.3.0: added source_context column; extended to all 10 remaining hub models."

column13: comment
ICD-O-3 morphology including /behaviour suffix. oBDS 0..5 -> hub 0..1 (n:1, selection of primary morphology required).
ECCDM recommends ICD-O-3. oBDS double-codes topography additionally as ICD-10-GM (obds:Tumorzuordnung.Primaertumor_ICD) -> terminology choice required.
oBDS code set (0/1/2/3/4/X/L/M/H/B/U/T). ECCDM separates system+value, value=string. tumourGradeSystem has NO oBDS field (implicit -> gap).
oBDS has ONE Diagnosedatum; ECCDM splits into visit/biopsy/imaging/lab -> subject broader (1:n). imagingDate/labReportDate have no oBDS source (gap).
Histologiedatum ~ BiopsyDate (histology specimen submission/receipt date).
Direct birth date mapping from Patienten_Stammdaten_Melder.

oBDS amtliches Geschlecht ~ sexAtBirth; X=amtlich unbestimmt differs from biological-sex concept. GAP: observedSexGender (no oBDS field); comorbiditiesAtCancerDiagnosis (no oBDS patient-level comorbidity field).

TNM.Version = UICC edition number (e.g. 8); hub classificationType expects staging-system/edition code. Terminology alignment needed. GAPs: stage.code (implicit in oBDS TNM structure; no explicit dimension-code field), evidenceReference, imagingReference; y/r/a symbols and L/V/Pn/S factors have no ECCDM hub elements.
T-component value populates one entry in stage backbone where stage.code=T-dimension. source_context=Diagnose (cTNM initial staging).
N-component; pTNM lymph node status typically from pathology report. source_context=Pathologie satisfies distinct source_context per shared object_id.
M-component; source_context=OP (post-surgical staging context). Distinct source_context from T/N rows required by SSSOM uniqueness rule.
CALCULATED: derived from T+N+M+indication factors per UICC rules. Maps to stage backbone entry where stage.code=overall-stage dimension code. source_context=Verlauf for uniqueness.
cTNM container element signals Clinical staging type in hub. Type=Clinical is derived from which TNM context (cTNM) is populated.
pTNM container signals Pathological staging type. source_context=Pathologie distinguishes from cTNM row (same object_id).
CALCULATED overall tumor status (K=complete remission, T=residual tumor, P=progression, R=recurrence, V=deceased, X=unknown). Terminology mapping to hub disease-status coding needed.
Follow-up assessment date maps directly to assertedDate.
Grading from Verlauf.Histologie sub-element; re-assessed grade during follow-up. tumourGradeSystem has no oBDS source (GAP). source_context=Verlauf distinguishes from Diagnose-context Grading row.

0..n organ-level metastasis codes per Verlauf map to metastaticSites. oBDS uses organ abbreviations; hub likely uses ICD-O/SNOMED site codes -> terminology conversion needed. GAP: locoRegionalSites (no oBDS explicit locoregional recurrence site field), extentType (no direct oBDS field).
No explicit alive/dead vital-status field in oBDS. Presence of Sterbedatum record implies Deceased; alive status requires absence-based inference. Near-GAP.
CALCULATED: K=no signs of tumor -> false; T/P/R=tumor present -> true. Hub is boolean; oBDS is coded enum. Indirect derivation.
ICD-coded cause(s) of death. oBDS allows 1..n Todesursache_ICD per Tod record; hub has 0..1 -> n:1 cardinality; primary cause selection needed.
Latest Verlauf.Untersuchungsdatum_Verlauf serves as last-follow-up date; temporal-last selection required across multiple Verlauf records.
Direct mapping; Sterbedatum = date of death.

CALCULATED Tumorstatus codes (K/T/P/R/V) map to treatment response categories (CR/SD/PR/PD). Terminology conversion to hub response coding required. GAPs: cancerConditionAtDiagnosisReference + clinicalCancerProgressionReference are structural.
Follow-up assessment date maps to treatment response evaluation date.
oBDS Intention: K=curative, P=palliative, S=locally curative, Prophylactic, Salvage. Terminology alignment to hub intent codes needed.
Start date of radiotherapy course.
End date of radiotherapy course.

oBDS Zielgebiet = radiotherapy target area coded with oBDS-specific Zielgebiet codes (2014 or 2021 version). Hub likely expects SNOMED/ICD-O anatomical site codes. Terminology gap. Seite_Zielgebiet (laterality) has no hub element.

Stellung_OP = relation to surgery (O=no relation to surgery, A=adjuvant, N=neoadjuvant, Z=additive, I=intraoperative). Maps to hub setting concept. GAPs: Gesamtdosis/Einzeldosis (dose), Strahlenart (modality), Applikationsart have no ECCDM Radiotherapy hub elements.
oBDS OP Intention: K=curative, P=palliative, D=diagnostic, R=revision, S=other. Terminology alignment to hub intent codes needed.

Surgical procedure date. GAPs: bodySite (no explicit body site field in oBDS OP; OPS procedure codes imply site but have no ECCDM hub target), Residualstatus R0/R1/R2 (in oBDS OP.Residualstatus but no ECCDM Surgery hub element).
oBDS systemic therapy intention: K=curative, P=palliative, S=other. Terminology alignment needed.
oBDS Therapieart codes (CH=chemotherapy, HO=hormone therapy, IM=immunotherapy, ZS=targeted therapy, SZ=stem cell transplant, etc.) map to hub treatment type. Terminology alignment needed.
Start date of systemic therapy course.
End date of systemic therapy course.

Stellung_OP = treatment timing relative to surgery (O=no relation to surgery, A=adjuvant, N=neoadjuvant, Z=additive). GAPs: ongoing (no oBDS boolean; derivable from absence of Ende date), SYST.Substanz/ATC (drug name/ATC codes have no ECCDM SystemicTreatment hub element).
